turns.question: What share of the customers who signed up in September 2026 placed an order within 30 days of signing up?
turns.answer: 33.3% (0.333) of the customers who signed up in September 2026 placed their first order within 30 days of signing up (the signup day and the 29 after it), per the Signup-to-first-order rate metric. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
